newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lone Star started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lone Star started.

text.p: Interstate/Johnson Lane said on Tuesday that it initiated coverage of the shares of Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Inc with a neutral rating, because of overall poor investor sentiment towards restaurant stocks.
-- Analyst Stephanie Haggerty said in a research note her 1997 earnings estimate was $2.00 per share and her 1998 earnings estimate was $2.40 per share.
-- She said Lone Star was well-managed and highly profitable and she expected the company to post reasonably strong earnings this year and next.

-- "However, investor sentiment against restaurant stocks in general and those suffering form worsening comparable-store sales in particular, may inhibit performance by Lone Star in the near to intermediate-term," Haggerty said.
-- Lone Star stock was off 3/8 at 23-1/2.
